pages.title: Ellie and Ben Christmas Eve
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Ellie and Ben Christmas Eve follows the couple as they prepare for their holiday celebration. Help decorate the Christmas tree and select festive clothing for both characters. Complete their seasonal preparations by putting together the decorations and outfits for the evening.

pages.title: Rocket Fest
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Rocket Fest has you steer a rocket along a course, collecting energy and useful items on the way. Move left or right to line up pickups before the final strike. Use what you have gathered to bombard the target at the end.

pages.title: Superhero Escape Run – Parkour Challenge!
pages.creator: DimenX Games
pages.description: Superhero Escape Run – Parkour Challenge! puts four superhero characters through dangerous escape courses. Run and jump through their environments, avoiding traps and obstacles as you look for a way out. Time your movements to keep each hero progressing through the stage.

pages.title: Blocks Stack Rush
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Blocks Stack Rush combines a running course with pixel-picture construction. Guide a small block character, collect pieces, and stack them for the image you need to make. Align the blocks correctly while racing the clock to complete the picture.

pages.title: Obby Draw to Escape
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Obby Draw to Escape lets you sketch the platforms your character needs to cross dangerous stages. Draw a walkable route around obstacles, gather stars, and reach the finish. Earn coins along the way and spend them on additional character skins.

pages.title: The specimen zero
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: The specimen zero has you searching unfamiliar rooms while hostile creatures hunt you. Find door keys, collect weapons and ammunition, and work toward an escape. Move between chambers while avoiding the monsters that threaten to end your search for a way out.

pages.title: SLIDE STONE
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: SLIDE STONE asks you to shift blocks sideways and complete rows across the board. Each move brings additional blocks up from below, steadily reducing your space. Clear several rows together or in consecutive moves to build combos and increase your score.

pages.title: Worm Out: Brain Teaser Games
pages.creator: Mamboo Games
pages.description: Worm Out: Brain Teaser Games presents mechanical puzzles about removing worms from fruit. Activate the available devices in the right sequence to pull out the pests. After clearing the fruit, decide which worms become butterflies and which are sent to the dungeon.

pages.title: Untangle Rings Master
pages.creator: Eccentric Games Studio
pages.description: Untangle Rings Master challenges you to separate interlocked rings and other shapes. Rotate the pieces and examine how they fit together to find an opening. Work through the tangled arrangement until you can free the objects from one another.

pages.title: Air Hockey Cup
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Air Hockey Cup turns hockey into a contest played by shooting player tokens at the puck. Line up shots to score and advance through leagues and tournaments. Spend winnings on stronger tokens, rings, and formations to change how your team takes the ice.

pages.title: Racing Car Driving Car Games
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Racing Car Driving Car Games offers city driving with vehicles including police cars and GT racers. Take a car onto the streets and practice its handling around traffic-filled roads. Use the boost for extra speed and reset the vehicle if it becomes stuck.

pages.title: Halloween Mazes
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Halloween Mazes challenges you to guide a skull-shaped ball from each maze entrance to its exit. Find a route through the twists before the countdown runs out. Complete twelve Halloween-themed puzzles by choosing turns that move you closer to safety.

pages.title: ZooCraft
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: ZooCraft lets you capture and tame animals while building your own zoo. Improve your abilities, construct enclosures, and travel to habitats ranging from meadows to deserts and Antarctica. Seek the different species in each region to expand the animals in your care.

pages.title: Realistic Wheelbarrow
pages.creator: ravel
pages.description: Realistic Wheelbarrow tasks you with pushing a wheelbarrow up a mountain along an obstacle-filled track. Keep it balanced while making progress toward the destination. Careful movement matters as the route's challenges threaten to upset the wheelbarrow before you reach the top.

pages.title: Jungle Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Jungle Mahjong asks you to clear a layout by pairing identical tiles. Choose pieces that have an exposed left or right side, since blocked tiles cannot be collected. Open up the arrangement with each pair until every tile is removed.

pages.title: Wood Dice Merge
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Wood Dice Merge gives you a five-by-five board for placing and combining dice. Rotate incoming pieces before setting them down, then bring together three dice showing the same value. Keep space available as you aim to create higher combinations.

pages.title: Super Hexbee Merger
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Super Hexbee Merger asks you to fit groups of colored hexagons onto a grid. Connect pieces of the same color, reach the target, and unlock a special merger hexagon. Plan the placement of each set, since the game ends when the grid fills.

pages.title: Shoot The Cannon
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Shoot The Cannon challenges you to topple block structures with a limited supply of cannonballs. Aim at positions that can bring down several blocks through one impact. Clear the arrangement by choosing where each shot will do the most useful damage.

pages.title: Revolution Offroad
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Revolution Offroad lets you tackle rough terrain in career, time-attack, and free-driving modes. Guide your truck to the finish while avoiding crashes and keeping track of fuel. Each route tests how well you manage the vehicle through difficult off-road conditions.

pages.title: Reckless Tetriz
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Reckless Tetriz has you fit falling block shapes into gaps to complete horizontal lines. Remove rows to keep the stack under control and preserve space for incoming pieces. The attempt ends if the uncleared blocks grow to the top of the board.

pages.title: Paper Rush
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Paper Rush is a one-button platformer set in a hand-drawn world. Time your jumps to cross platforms and avoid spikes, then reach the black hole that ends the stage. Collect every star along the route to earn a perfect completion.

pages.title: American Truck Car Driving
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description: American Truck Car Driving puts you in charge of transporting cargo between locations around a city. Pick up a load and follow the ground arrows toward its delivery point. Navigate the truck along the marked route to bring the freight to its destination.

pages.title: Cool Archer
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Cool Archer challenges you to hit archery targets and score points for accurate shots. Adjust your aim and timing to approach the bullseye. Later challenges introduce moving targets and stronger wind, requiring you to account for more than a stationary board.

pages.title: 18 Wheeler Driving Sim
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: 18 Wheeler Driving Sim has you transport freight along difficult roads while limiting damage to the load. Guide the large truck through changing scenery and deliver cargo carefully. Earn money from jobs and unlock additional freight to carry on later trips.

pages.title: Super Craft Bros Runner
pages.creator: 6woo.com
pages.description: Super Craft Bros Runner sends a blocky hero after a robber to recover gold. Keep running, collect coins, and dodge obstacles along the endless route. Your goal is to extend the chase while gathering as much of the scattered gold as possible.

pages.title: Wordling Daily Challenge
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Wordling Daily Challenge asks you to identify a five-letter word within five guesses. Enter a word and study the colored feedback on its letters and the keyboard. Use those clues to narrow the possibilities and place the correct letters before your chances expire.

pages.title: Falling Lovers
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Falling Lovers is a physics puzzle about reuniting separated partners. Rotate the blocks holding them and use gravity to guide each character toward the right destination. Choose the angles carefully so the falling lovers land where they can meet.

pages.title: Run Blue imposter Run
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Run Blue imposter Run challenges a blue impostor to survive 22 stages full of hazards. Move through each level while watching for dangerous flying creatures. Learn where the threats lie and guide the character through the increasingly difficult routes.

pages.title: Mine Rope Rescue
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Mine Rope Rescue asks you to guide three stranded block-world characters down from a high hill. Secure a rope route between rocks so they can descend safely. Plan the line around dangers rather than sending the group into a hazardous path.

pages.title: SpeedBall
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: SpeedBall uses one-tap controls for a survival challenge built around differently colored squares. Collect red squares to gain points while avoiding the dark ones. Try to keep the run alive long enough to reach the game's fifty-point target.

pages.title: Tricky Shapes
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Tricky Shapes challenges you to fill a given outline with a collection of pieces. Drag the shapes into position and work out how their edges fit together. Rearrange your choices until every piece occupies the space needed to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Arkadium's Mahjongg Dimensions 350 seconds
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Arkadium's Mahjongg Dimensions 350 seconds turns tile matching into a three-dimensional puzzle. Rotate the structure to find matching pairs with exposed sides and remove them. Clear the tiles before time expires, using each match to uncover pieces deeper inside the arrangement.

pages.title: 15 Puzzle
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: 15 Puzzle turns a chosen picture into a sliding-tile challenge with one empty space. Move neighboring tiles into the gap to restore the image. Work out an efficient sequence while trying to finish the arrangement in the shortest time possible.

pages.title: Dump Trucks Match 3
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Dump Trucks Match 3 asks you to line up at least three matching trucks. Clear groups to earn points and replenish the time meter before it empties. Keep making matches quickly enough to continue into the increasingly difficult levels.

pages.title: Angels Girl Group Meetup
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Angels Girl Group Meetup has a group of friends deciding what to wear for their gathering. Help them settle on makeup and clothing, choosing between formal and casual possibilities. Put together a complete look for each girl before the meetup.

pages.title: Flappy Pig
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Flappy Pig challenges you to keep a flying pig moving through obstacles. Tap to make it rise and control its height as the route passes by. Avoid collisions and extend the flight to improve the score from your previous attempt.

pages.title: ZEBRA HUNTER
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: ZEBRA HUNTER is a first-person hunting game set in mountain valleys and riverside terrain. Search the landscape for zebras and aim using the available semi-automatic sniper rifles. Move around the map as you work through its sixteen hunting stages.

pages.title: Watermelon and Drinks Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Watermelon and Drinks Puzzle offers six jigsaws featuring fruit and refreshments. Choose a picture, then select a piece count ranging from sixteen to one hundred. Drag the sections together to rebuild the original image at your chosen level of difficulty.

pages.title: Car Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Car Rush has you drive along a road while avoiding the obstacles that threaten your car. Stay in motion for as long as possible and react to what appears ahead. Each attempt gives you another chance to beat your previous survival score.

pages.title: Walk Master
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Walk Master asks you to move a character forward using sliding inputs. Place each step carefully and avoid the piles of waste on the route, since stepping into one ends the attempt. Try to travel farther with each walking run.

pages.title: Jelly Time 2020
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Jelly Time 2020 gives you block pieces to fit into a grid. Complete horizontal or vertical lines to remove them and make space for more placements. Rotate the pieces and choose their positions while working within each level's time restriction.

pages.title: GT Highway Car Driving : Busy Roads Racer 2020
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: GT Highway Car Driving : Busy Roads Racer 2020 puts you on an endless road alongside fast-moving traffic. Drive through the busy highway and try the available modes. Customize your setup and switch camera angles to change your view of the racing action.

pages.title: Homer City 3D
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Homer City 3D turns baseball hitting into a contest to break windows in the opposite building. Face an opponent and time your contact with the ball to send it into the glass. Accuracy determines how well you perform in the window-breaking competition.

pages.title: 2020 Realistic Tank Battle Simulation
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: 2020 Realistic Tank Battle Simulation gives you a tank to drive through a series of combat missions. Move across the battlefield, choose a target, and fire with mouse aiming. Complete the mission or restart it to try a different approach to the battle.

pages.title: Dead Paradise 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Dead Paradise 3 combines hazardous driving with a mission to get survivors to a safe haven. Steer through a damaged world filled with obstacles, gunfire, and explosions. Keep the journey going while dealing with the threats along the road to safety.

pages.title: Treasures of the Mystic Sea
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: Treasures of the Mystic Sea is a pirate-themed match-three puzzle set underwater. Match groups of at least three identical pieces and use the resulting clears to meet each stage's objectives. Work through the board while uncovering the sea's treasure-themed challenges.

pages.title: Slide
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Slide asks you to rearrange blocks until they link a starting source to its destination. Move the available pieces and examine how their paths connect. Complete an unbroken route through the layout to solve each of the block puzzles.

pages.title: Catch the Candy
pages.creator: Yohoho Games
pages.description: Catch the Candy follows a creature with a long, sticky arm across 75 puzzle stages. Extend the arm to grip surrounding objects and pull yourself toward the sweet. Use the scenery to negotiate each arrangement and finally reach the candy.

pages.title: Holiday Crossword
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Holiday Crossword presents word grids built around travel and seasonal topics, including cities, food, celebrations, and gifts. Select a clue and enter its answer into the grid. Use crossing letters to work out the remaining words and complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Flappy Cave Bat
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Flappy Cave Bat has you guide a bat through a cave by controlling its flapping. Click or tap to gain height, then let it descend between inputs. Time the flight so the bat passes the obstacles without crashing into them.

pages.title: City Of Gang Street Fighting
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: City Of Gang Street Fighting puts two customizable fighters against gangs in a polygonal city. Combine attacks, jumping kicks, defensive moves, and grabs to defeat opponents. React quickly when enemies close in, and break free if one catches you in a hold.

pages.title: Oil Hunt
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Oil Hunt challenges you to extend a pipe far enough to reach underground oil. Judge the required length as you guide oil-hungry characters through different landscapes. Build your score and unlock more characters while searching for the next supply.

pages.title: Super Cleaner
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Super Cleaner turns gathering rubbish into a score challenge. Control the cleaning action with the mouse and collect as much garbage as you can. Clear the litter in front of you while working toward a larger total for the cleaning session.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Learns Vehicles
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Learns Vehicles follows Hazel as she prepares for her first day at school. Help her get ready and join her classmates for learning activities. Respond to the characters' needs as Hazel discovers the classroom and spends time with new friends.

pages.title: Broken Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Broken Cars Jigsaw features five pictures of damaged vehicles for you to reconstruct. Choose an image and the number of pieces you want to use. Drag each section into its correct location until the complete car picture is restored.

pages.title: City Ambulance Simulator
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: City Ambulance Simulator puts you in the driver's seat of an ambulance responding to injured people. Take on rescue-driving duties around the city and reach those who need assistance. Guide the emergency vehicle through the streets to carry out its lifesaving role.

pages.title: Punch Superhero
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Punch Superhero lets you move through a city as a flying hero fighting gangsters. Combine ground movement and jumps with flight, shooting, and a laser attack. Carry out the superhero missions while confronting enemies threatening the people in the city.

pages.title: Tiny Battle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Tiny Battle puts you in command of a human army defending a castle against orcs. Train soldiers and ranged units, then manage your forces as the invaders advance. Use your available troop types to stop the attackers from destroying the stronghold.

pages.title: Hard Truck
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Hard Truck challenges you to drive a monster truck over demanding tracks. Hold the input to accelerate and release it to brake or reverse. Control your speed through the rough course as you work toward handling each difficult section successfully.

pages.title: EG Sharp Rings
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Sharp Rings has you guide a ring along a continuous line. Click or touch to move the ring upward or downward as the route changes direction. The increasing speed makes it harder to keep your movements aligned with the path.

pages.title: Ludo Play
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Ludo Play offers a color-based race around the familiar board. Choose red, green, blue, or yellow, then roll the die and move your pieces toward home. Roll a six to bring a piece into play and begin its journey around the track.

pages.title: Shatter Glass
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Shatter Glass challenges you to break the cups in each level using balls. Send the balls toward the glass targets and try to clear the arrangement. Work through the stages by choosing shots that connect with the remaining cups.

pages.title: Ranger vs Zombies
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Ranger vs Zombies arms a ranger against undead enemies on the ground and in the air. Fire the shotgun or call on firestorm, lightning, and ice abilities to fight them. Gather coins, items, and improvements while pushing through the zombie attacks.

pages.title: Attacking the Space Base
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Attacking the Space Base sends your ship toward a base through a field of comets and hostile spacecraft. Dodge the obstacles and return fire at enemies shooting at you. Survive the journey through the attack to reach the space base safely.

pages.title: BFF Moods Dressup
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: BFF Moods Dressup has Mia and Emma trying looks inspired by different moods. Pick a theme such as Love, Crazy, or Party, then select clothing to fit it. Put together outfits for the friends that reflect the mood you chose.

pages.title: Hidden Christmas Cookies
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Hidden Christmas Cookies challenges you to search festive scenes for concealed treats. Find all five cookies in a level to unlock the next picture. Look closely through the Christmas details and mark each cookie when you discover its hiding place.

pages.title: Sky High
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Sky High challenges you to build a tall tower by timing the placement of successive blocks. Tap at the right moment to align each new section. The placements grow harder as you climb, with power-ups including Reverse, Repeat, Insurance, and Double Coins.

pages.title: High School Gossip
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: High School Gossip lets you join a messenger conversation after Rob returns from Europe. Follow his friends as they discuss the trip, school rumors, and teenage drama. Take part in the chat as the group's conversation moves between the different stories.

pages.title: Halloween House Maker
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Halloween House Maker gives you decorations for turning a home into a haunted setting. Browse the Halloween props and combine them into your own spooky design. Arrange the house's seasonal look using the available furnishings and decorative choices.

pages.title: Ice Queen Vaccines Injection
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ice Queen Vaccines Injection is a doctor-roleplay game about preparing a princess for a shot. Give her vitamins, check her heartbeat, and clean the treatment area. Follow the injection sequence and finish by caring for the spot where the shot was given.

pages.title: A Pixel Adventure Vol1
pages.creator: Crimson Games IO
pages.description: A Pixel Adventure Vol1 sends you through a castle with more than forty individually designed dungeons. Fight enemies, discover secret areas, and revisit rooms to gather more gold. Spend your findings at shops selling swords, armor, and potions for the journey.

pages.title: Princess Carpool Karaoke
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Carpool Karaoke combines a singing-show theme with princess styling. Choose one of six princesses to join James Corden's fantasyland drive, then prepare her outfit. Browse the fashion options to create the look she will wear for her karaoke appearance.

pages.title: Princess Dressing Room
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Dressing Room invites you into a pregnant princess's wardrobe to help her get dressed. Look through the available clothing and find pieces that work together. Assemble an outfit for her by making the choices in the dressing-room styling session.

pages.title: Princess InstaChallange
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princess InstaChallange gathers Cinderella, Ariel, Elsa, and Anna for a fashion competition on Princessgram. Create a different style for each princess using the clothing selection. Put together four coordinated looks to prepare their entries for the latest outfit challenge.

pages.title: White Kittens Bride Contest
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: White Kittens Bride Contest has Talking Angela and Sheriff Callie preparing for weddings on the same day. Help the feline brides choose wedding dresses and suitable accessories. Assemble their bridal looks as they compete over whose celebration outfit will stand out.

pages.title: Super Stack
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Super Stack challenges you to place all the supplied shapes into a physics-driven stack. Build your arrangement carefully and account for how the pieces balance against one another. Complete the stack without letting the structure become too unstable to hold together.

pages.title: Princesses on Catwalk
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princesses on Catwalk asks you to prepare two princesses for a fashion competition. Pick clothing and other fashion items to build an outfit for each contestant. Complete their styling so both are ready to present their looks on the runway.

pages.title: Elsa Scary Halloween Makeup
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Elsa Scary Halloween Makeup begins with a spa treatment to prepare Elsa's face for Halloween styling. Apply masks and deal with blemishes, then choose contouring and patterned eyeshadow. Finish with face paint to complete the queen's eerie party look.

pages.title: Princesses Sparkle Fashion
pages.creator: Next Vision Solutions
pages.description: Princesses Sparkle Fashion puts you in charge of dressing princesses for an evening with their boyfriends. Choose clothes and accessories to create bright, coordinated looks for the outing. Work through the wardrobe options and finish each princess's outfit for the night.
